title: How Does a Phone Charger Really Work?
short_title: How a Phone Charger Really Works
description: How does a phone charger really work? Here is the simple science of AC to DC, lithium ions and fast charging.

comment: What phone do you use? Does it charge fast? 🔌

scenes.text: How does your phone charger really work?
The wall gives strong alternating current, which changes direction many times a second. Your phone needs a gentle, steady, low voltage flow.
Inside the charger, tiny parts lower the voltage and turn the current into a steady flow in one direction.
In the battery, that flow pushes tiny charged particles called lithium ions from one layer to another. That is how energy gets stored.
Fast chargers and phones talk to each other first, and agree on how much power is safe.
Near full, charging slows down to protect the battery.
